shortDesc: One notification: who replied to your post or comment, the post title, an excerpt and the age, as plain attributes; unread ones carry an orange dot. Links to the comment. Usually rendered by g-notification-list.

props.name: comment-id
props.description: The reply's comment id (for the link anchor).

props.name: read
props.description: Present once the notification has been read.

styling.tailwindClasses: grid grid-cols-[10px_1fr_auto] gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-white px-3 py-2
styling.notes: Orange unread dot; grey excerpt; relative time on the right.
